definition: a line of things or people next to each other
description: Farm workers in sun hats kneel in a field at dawn, transplanting seedlings along a stretched string so the plants form a perfectly straight line; a drone shot reveals dozens of workers planting one long straight line across the field. One says the line is nice and even.
transcript: Nice and even. All in one line.

taps.target: the person in the blue shirt
the man in the pink hat
